notes.title: Tonight is the night!
notes.notes:
I am heartily greatful to everyone who made this possible: Artem, Olga & X-Calibur for their permanent help with any weird stuff, Leonizer & Lesson Of Passion for long-term support, Will Atkers for the most funniest parts, Philipp Dose for German localisation and finding so many bugs. And of cause Oleg Okunev & Dmitry Sinkevich for fantastic artwork.

But all that work would be meaningless without the support of our Steam audience, the great people who stays with us in spite of delays, bugs and other stupidity that are my sole responsibility.

Thank you!

PS. Yes, we plan to add voices, as soon as we could find the way to do it.
PPS. And we are almost ready to announce something completely different and exciting very soon, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Jerry is getting laid in October 2023!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628480/50df2e35e0a4cd024162c686907167df24110f63.png[/img]

It has been a 3-year journey for us, and it is almost complete.

The game most likely will be without the voice acting on release. This process was delayed due to circumstances beyond our control. We don't want to postpone the release date again, so we plan to add voices a little later.

[h2]Sunwave Hotel[/h2]
By the way, our friend Will Atkers, who wrote all the dialogues for Jerry, has now released his game on Steam, so it’s worth to check it out

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2010210

notes.title: Demo is here!
notes.notes:
Hi guys!

Unfortunately the war between Russia and Ukraine have made a great impact on us, as our team are international Russian\Ukrainian. Still we are doing our  best  to keep going and finally the demo is here. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628480/c5c8dc0255c4b453e8e45408ae1256c4ecc212fd.gif[/img]

Initially we plan to release the  demo as M17 rated, but Valve made us to set it Adult Only. So don't expect much AO content here (even in "no censorship mode"), but will be much more in full version.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628480/d8dc5fcdf4fdb8e1418ac669e754317cc7c9e41d.gif[/img]

We hope you will find this demo fun enough to wait for the full release. And we promise to make more updates about it.

Thanks  for your support!
Do sex not  wars.

notes.title: Jerry's early days
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! It's time to talk about the current state of the project.

Basically, the script was sorted out, the details remained. We like the result - specific humor, funny riddles (almost without platitudes and practically without idiocy).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628480/d544f0bae3b70e022f73e70dd15e47c8fe1e71c9.jpg[/img]

We are working on locations, we have conceived 18 of them. All locations for the demo are ready (10), and the rest will be finished pretty soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628480/b74d99e84ca0f8fbdd4b093f532a191c3b8cd004.jpg[/img]

Characters. Everyone is ready for the demo, but not all of them =)
We still draw and animate.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628480/d28690e7f9c7ce99d6d424750e884b80e23b5aa3.png[/img]

Demo. We hope this year, it is impossible to say more precisely yet.

notes.title: Jerry Wanker Reveal
notes.notes:
We are thrilled to announce a hilarious classic point-and-click adventure starring a new romantic hero Jerry Wanker! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39628480/7173c7dce1712feac6d5fc47d970ca83dfc0e73e.png[/img]

Players will guide [strike]Larry[/strike] Jerry through various situation on his way to expand theoretical knowledge about sex.  A raving party is taking place next door. Jerry really wants to get there, despite the various unusual events taking place in his hometown Blueballs Falls.

But getting to the party is only part of the story. He still needs to get rid of competitors for women’s attention! And this is a more difficult task.

Jerry will run into plenty of awfully funny puzzles, weird characters, and collect a pile of crap items.

We believe we can make it with your support.
Follow us, add to wishlist and wait for exciting news about [b]Jerry Wanker and the Quest to get Laid[/b]!
